# foundry_index (Data Source)

Looks up an Azure AI Search-backed index version by name. When `version` is omitted, the service's current latest version is returned. Other index kinds are rejected rather than misrepresented as Azure AI Search.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foundry_index" "knowledge" {
  name    = "knowledge-index"
  version = "1"
}

output "knowledge_index_id" {
  value = data.foundry_index.knowledge.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the index to look up.

### Optional

- `version` (String) Version of the index. Omit to resolve the service's current latest version.

### Read-Only

- `connection_name` (String) Azure AI Search connection name, when returned by the service.
- `description` (String) Description returned for the index version, when present.
- `field_mapping` (Attributes) Azure AI Search field mapping, when returned by the service. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--field_mapping))
- `id` (String) Service-assigned index asset identifier, or `name:version` when the service omits one.
- `index_name` (String) Underlying Azure AI Search index name, when returned by the service.
- `tags` (Map of String) Tags returned for the index version, when present.
- `type` (String) Index type. This data source currently accepts `AzureSearch`.

<a id="nestedatt--field_mapping"></a>
### Nested Schema for `field_mapping`

Read-Only:

- `content_fields` (List of String) Fields containing text content.
- `filepath_field` (String) Field containing the source file path.
- `metadata_fields` (List of String) Fields containing metadata.
- `title_field` (String) Field containing the document title.
- `url_field` (String) Field containing the document URL.
- `vector_fields` (List of String) Fields containing vector content.
